maps.points.west_woods.a02.title: Go downstairs → Sanctum of the Last Flame
maps.points.west_woods.b01.detail: At (24, -28) Contact the torches in the birch forest, smash the torches, or shoot them with the Ranger option.
maps.points.west_woods.b03.detail: At (31, -16) Explore the burned-up nameless tomb. Use Voidshard, raise a Spirit Lantern, or perform a summoning ritual using the options of a Voidcaller.
maps.points.west_woods.choice-xp-20: First time learning, with 30 gold coins
maps.points.west_woods.choice-xp-30: First inquiry about the expedition team's plans
maps.points.west_woods.detail: An unnamed tomb. A charred wooden cross is embedded diagonally in the wet soil.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-10:
The party steps on the tile at (-11, 10).
After discovering the Soulforge, the party steps on the tile at (-11, 10).
maps.points.west_woods.detail-11: Receive Soulcleaver, Axe of the Deep Forge
maps.points.west_woods.detail-14:
The first interrogation task opens two assignments.
Ale of Desperation · Deliver 10 flowers Green Alecap, 5 gold coins per flower, Additionally, 200 experience points are obtained.
Iron and Ash · Take Moonsteel Ore Reward, the first forging task is completed.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-16:
Each piece of equipment can be forged only once.
Moonsteel Helmet, Moonsteel Gloves, Moonsteel Boots, Moonsteel Shield1 piece is required for each item Moonsteel Ore50 gold coins are needed.
Moonsteel Armor2 pieces are required Moonsteel Ore This option requires having 100 gold coins, but only 50 gold coins are actually deducted.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-18: Beginners pay 30 gold coins, including Reinforced Pickaxe You can purchase additional items with 10 gold coins after learning the skill Reinforced Pickaxe.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-20: Beginners pay 40 gold coins, including Golden Chisel After learning, it can be purchased with 20 gold coins Golden Chisel.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-22: Party member required: When it's a dwarf, select the dwarf-exclusive dialogue from the main menu to obtain it all at once Warblood Tonic, Warblood Tonic (Recipe)And 100 experience points.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-24: Brenna will change her dialogue based on the state of the dragon. After discovering the Soul Forge, a subsequent menu will appear.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-25: The forest path thins to a muddy track between dark pines. A rough barricade blocks the way.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-27:
"Easy, brother. Ask what you need to." (Requires Dwarf)
“We came looking for Durok.”
Try to remember. (Requires Dwarf)
maps.points.west_woods.detail-28: The trees open into a rough dwarven camp. Timber walls, smoking forges, and half-finished huts wedged between the roots.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-29: The tile at (2, 4) activates when the party steps on it or an object holds it down.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-3:
Conduct a summoning ritual, Call upon the demon. (Party member required: Voidcaller)
Use Voidshard Awaken the Soul. (Possessed) Voidshard)
Raise it up Spirit Lantern. (Hold it.) Spirit Lantern)
maps.points.west_woods.detail-31: The forge spits and growls, casting red light across the house walls. A dwarf stands by the anvil. Broad, scarred, his beard matted with soot and iron rings. His armor's battered, the look of someone who's fought more than he's rested.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-33: Receive Dwarven Forgebrew(Option: "What happens after the dragon dies?") The dragon is dead. It was not defeated by the dwarf team. The mission "The Last Forge Burns" failed.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-34: The Soul Warden drifts under the hanging torches. The flames inside tremble.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-35: At (26, -28) Enemies have stepped on it
maps.points.west_woods.detail-36: "Begone. You have no place in this world." (Requires Paladin)
maps.points.west_woods.detail-37: The mission "The Light That Burns Twice" has not failed yet
maps.points.west_woods.detail-38: Receive Lantern Key(Option: "Smash the hanging torches.")
maps.points.west_woods.detail-39: You step into a quiet birch glade where mist curls low around the roots.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-4:
Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” Not currently in progress, The torches are still intact
Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” In progress, The torches have been broken

The spirits of the torches still linger
maps.points.west_woods.detail-40: At (26, -28) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.west_woods.detail-41: Only shards of glass cling to the blackened chain. Whatever once burned here is gone.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-43: Nock an arrow and shoot the lantern. (Requires Ranger)
maps.points.west_woods.detail-44:
The torches have been broken
The torches are still intact
Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” Completed
maps.points.west_woods.detail-45: At the end of the forest lies a scorched clearing. The ash covers your boots, and the air is filled with the smell of burned steel and death.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-46:
The party steps on the tile at (19, -15).
The party steps on the tile at (17, -16).
maps.points.west_woods.detail-47: For long hours you walked through the dark tunnel beneath the mountains. Stone above, stone below and nothing stirring in between.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-48: At (37, -27) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.west_woods.detail-50: When "The Light That Burns Twice" can still be completed, escort the Soul Warden to (26, -28). Then, choose to fight against it, or challenge it using the exclusive options of the Paladin.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-6: A low hum fills the clearing. A dwarf kneels before the old stone, tracing runes in the dust.
maps.points.west_woods.detail-8: Receive Durok's Promise (Quests “Heart of the Mountain” In progress, The dragon is still alive)
maps.points.west_woods.detail-9: The dwarven leader listens in silence as you speak of the anvil hidden in the depths.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue: Event opening (Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” Not currently in progress, The torches are still intact)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-10: A faint vibration hums through the ground beneath your boots. The same strange pull you felt in the glade with the lantern.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-100: "He forgets faith. He forgets why we came, to build, not destroy, to awaken the flame, not feed it with corpses."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-101: "Still, I cannot fault his heart, only his fear."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-102: Choose “Offer help with the dragon.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-103: "If you stand with Korr, remember there is more than one way to win a battle. The wyrm's fate rests with you now."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-104: "My visions show what is coming. Korr will act, and nothing I say will turn him." Durok's eyes glint with weary certainty. "All I ask is that you guide his hand when the time comes."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-105: "If battle finds you, strike the stone, not the heart."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-107: "Go then. The mountain keeps its secrets, but not forever." He turns back toward the runes on the altar.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-108: His expression does not shift in shock, only in recognition.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-109: For a moment, you have the sense that he was expecting your return.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-11: Perform a summoning ritual to call the demon. (Requires Voidcaller)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-110: "You have done more for my people than you know."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-111: He closes his eyes and takes a long breath.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-113: Durok looks toward the entrance to the ruins. For the first time, you see him smile.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-114: His hands tighten around the hammer. He seems almost impatient to begin.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-115: You cannot help wondering what he intends to create with such power. If the promised rebirth would save the dwarves... or doom them to something far worse.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-117: "And when its fire answers, I will forge what I owe you."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-119: Not for hours, but for days.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-12: Use a Void Shard to awaken the spirit. (With Voidshard)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-120: When Durok returns, the smell of smoke and iron clings to him.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-121: His eyes are dulled by exhaustion, heavy with the burden of keeping the void leashed and obedient.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-122: He sets it in your hands without ceremony. The firstborn of the awakened Soulforge.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-123: The weight is wrong. Too light, then suddenly not. As if it is still deciding what it wants to be.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-124: Durok straightens and gives a single, firm nod.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-125: "Wherever your road leads, may your strikes be true."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-126: He turns back toward the forge.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-129: As Durok turns toward the depths of the forge, a quiet certainty settles in you.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-13: Raise the Spirit Lantern. (With Spirit Lantern)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-130: You will not see that remarkable dwarf again.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-131: Event opening (The Soul Forge has been discovered)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-134: "The camp's empty. Everyone moved underground once the Soulforge was found."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-135: "If you want to buy anything, do it now. I'm heading down."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-137: "Well, if it isn't the dragonslayer," she says with a half-grin. "Try not to melt my forge next, aye? Some of us still need the heat."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-138: Event opening (The dragon is still alive)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-139: "Heard you let the great beast live," she says, hefting her hammer. "Brave or foolish, can't say. Good work anyway."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-140: Event opening (The Dragon is not yet dead, The Dragon is dead)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-141: "Back again? Careful, hangin' 'round a forge too long makes folk think ye're useful." She smirks, then grabs her hammer and leans on it.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-142: The air hums with the deep glow of burning coals. What once was a campfire has been reforged into a forge. A crude anvil set beside the flame, sparks bursting into the damp forest air.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-143: The smell of iron and smoke hangs thick between the trees. A sturdy dwarf woman stands by the fire, sleeves rolled, hammer resting against her shoulder.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-144: "Name's Brenna Ironsong. Smith, trader, part-time mother to a dozen halfwit miners who think axes fix everything."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-145: Event opening (The Dragon is not yet dead)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-146: "Don't just stand there starin', lad," she growls. "This ain't a campfire - it's work. And work don't stop till the steel cools." She wipes her hands on a dirty cloth.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-147: Choose “Enough talk for now.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-148: We'd like to see what you're selling.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-149: How are things holding up here?
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-15: Event opening (The spirits of the torches still linger)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-150: Can you teach us some dwarven craft?
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-151: Got any work that needs doing?
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-153: "The forge feels like home. You temper your work well, sister." (Party member required: Dwarf, Available once)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-155: Choose “The forge feels like home. You temper your work well, sister.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-156: Brenna's eyes narrow for a heartbeat then soften. "A dwarf, eh? Thought I was the only fool hammerin' metal this far from a proper hall."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-157: She gives a short nod, pride flickering behind soot and sweat. "If you've got kin's hands, I'll trust your word more than any outsider's."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-158: She reaches under the anvil and pulls a small flask. "Here. Forgebrew. Keeps the lungs from fillin' with smoke." She grins and shoves it into your hand.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-159: Brenna lowers her voice slightly. "Recipe's simple enough once you know it. Crush a bit of Solarbloom for the heat, grind in petals of Amberrose for the bite..."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-16: The ground trembles as the Wraith's scream echoes through the rocks. The burned cross shudders, bleeding pale light from its cracks.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-160: She taps the side of the flask with a thick finger. "...and then a careful splash of good old poison. Not enough to kill you of course."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-161: Choose “We'd like to see what you're selling.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-162: "Aye, aye. Business first - I like that. But mind ye, I don't sell junk. Every piece here's got my sweat on it."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-163: Select “Got any work that needs doing?” / “About the quests...” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-164: "Work?" Brenna lets out a laugh that could bend iron. "Ye must be jokin'. In this gods-forsaken pit, we're drownin' in work - just short on hands that know which end o' a hammer does the hittin'."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-165: "See that pile of busted tools? All mine. Half the camp thinks a hammer's a bloody spoon. And don't get me started on Korr - wants blades sharper than dragon teeth but keeps swingin' 'em at rocks." She exhales, glaring at the forge.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-166: "And then there's Durok, preachin' about holy fire and divine anvils while I'm patchin' boots with wire."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-167: "Still... ye asked, so here's what's needin' doin' if ye've the stomach for it."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-168: Select “Got any work that needs doing?” / “About the quests...”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-169: "First problem. We're runnin' low on ale." She says it with the tone of a woman describin' the end of the world. "No grain, no hops, no spirits left."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-17: Choose “Perform a summoning ritual to call the demon.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-170: "So we'll need... alternatives." Brenna lowers her voice and glances around the camp as if the trees themselves might be listenin'. "There's a kind o' mushroom. Big, green, ugly thing that grows on wet stone. Boil it long enough, and it'll make somethin' close enough to ale."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-171: "But don't ye *dare* tell the others. If word gets out I'm brewin' fungus beer, we'll have a dwarven revolt on our hands."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-172: "Bring me a handful o' those shrooms and I'll make sure no one dies o' thirst."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-173: "Second thing. Ore." Brenna's tone shifts; this time it's not jest. "Not the junk we dig from these hills. I'm talkin' old ore, the kind smelted before kings learned how to wear crowns."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-174: "There's traces of it deep in the ruins. The old dwarves called it Moonsteel. If I can get a few proper chunks, I might just forge somethin' worth singin' about." She smirks, but the pride in her voice is real.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-175: "Back already? Don't tell me ye finished everythin'." She grins, wiping soot off her cheek with the back of her hand.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-176: "So? What've ye got? Mushrooms or metal?"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-178: We have found some moonsteel ore.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-18: You draw a circle of ash and whisper the ancient words. The ground cracks and a stream of pale fire seeps from the grave.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-180: Choose “We have some mushrooms.” (With Green Alecap ×10)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-181: "Got the shrooms, have ye?" Brenna raises a brow, amused. "Good. Keep 'em wrapped tight - smell travels faster than gossip 'round here."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-182: "Once I boil 'em down, we'll have somethin' that almost passes for ale. Don't look at me like that - desperate times, lad. Aye... this might just save the camp from despair."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-183: "Now, if anyone asks, this never happened."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-184: Choose “We have some mushrooms.” (Without Green Alecap ×10)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-185: "Hmph. Ye call that a handful? I said ten. Ten proper ones, not the shriveled crumbs ye've scraped off a log."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-186: Choose “We have some mushrooms.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-187: "Already brought me the shrooms, remember?" She grins, stirring something suspiciously frothy in a pot nearby. "Turned out better than expected. I think."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-188: Choose “We have found some moonsteel ore.” (With Moonsteel Ore)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-189: "Ye found the ore, eh? Let's see it!" Brenna's eyes widen as she takes the metal from your hands. "Aye... that's the stuff."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-190: "Ye've done well. Tell me, lad - what shall we make from this gift of the old world?" She rests her hand on the anvil, firelight dancing in her eyes.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-191: Forge a Dwarven Helm (1 ore, 50 gold)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-194: Forge a Dwarven Shield (1 ore, 50 gold)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-197: Choose “We have found some moonsteel ore.” (Without Moonsteel Ore)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-198: "Ore, ye say?" Brenna squints at your empty hands and snorts. "I see nothin' but air."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-199: "Ye can't forge dreams, lad. Though gods know I've tried. Bring me the real thing."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-2: A nameless grave. A burned wooden cross leaning in damp soil.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-20: Choose “Use a Void Shard to awaken the spirit.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-200: Choose “Forge a Dwarven Helm (1 ore, 50 gold)”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-201: "Fifty gold for the work, lad. And trust me, that is almost for free. Ore's rare, but coal, oil, leather straps and broken hammer-heads don't pay for themselves."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-202: Choose “Forge a Dwarven Helm (1 ore, 50 gold)” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-203: "Helm? I've already forged ye one o' those! What, plan on wearin' it on both heads?" She smirks and shakes her head. "Pick somethin' else, lad."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-204: "A helm, eh? Aye, protect the brain, even if ye don't use it much." She grins, heating the forge until it roars. "There. Forged strong and true. May it keep ye from gettin' yer skull split."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-205: Choose “Forge Dwarven Gauntlets (1 ore, 50 gold)” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-206: "Gauntlets again? Ye'll have more gloves than hands if ye keep askin'." She snorts. "Try somethin' new."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-208: "Gloves, eh? Fine choice. Keeps the fingers where they belong." She works the bellows, sparks bursting like fireworks. "There - tempered well. Don't use 'em to punch walls, unless ye want new ones."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-209: Choose “Forge Dwarven Boots (1 ore, 50 gold)” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-21: You press the Voidshard into the damp earth. It pulses once, low and hungry.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-210: "Boots again? What, did ye kick a troll to death in the last pair?" She laughs. "One's enough. Try somethin' else."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-212: "Boots, eh? Smart choice. Good boots'll carry ye further than any sword." She hammers, sparks flying like stars. "Walk proud and don't stomp holes in the floor."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-213: Choose “Forge a Dwarven Shield (1 ore, 50 gold)” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-214: "Aye, ye've already got a shield. Plan on hidin' behind two now?" She shakes her head with a smirk.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-215: Choose “Forge a Dwarven Shield (1 ore, 50 gold)”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-216: "A shield, aye? Ye plan on stayin' alive. Good for ye." She shapes the metal into a round slab, runes glowing faintly. "Holds true against fang and flame."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-217: Choose “Forge Dwarven Armor (2 ore, 100 gold)” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-218: "Ye already got yer armor, lad. What next, want me to plate yer beard too?" She smirks, folding her arms. "Save the ore for somethin' new."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-219: Choose “Forge Dwarven Armor (2 ore, 100 gold)” (With Moonsteel Ore ×2)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-22: Cracks crawl through the soil as something answers from underneath.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-220: "Armor, eh? Ambitious. I like it." Brenna cracks her neck and sets to work, sweat and sparks mixing in the air. "Took more ore than I'd like, but she's a beauty. Tough enough to laugh at dragonfire."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-221: "Ye wear this, lad, and remember who forged it. Every dent'll sing my name."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-222: Choose “Forge Dwarven Armor (2 ore, 100 gold)” (Without Moonsteel Ore ×2)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-223: "Ye've not brought enough ore! Two chunks, I said. Not one."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-225: "Changed yer mind, eh? Fine. The metal's not goin' anywhere." She snorts and returns to the anvil.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-226: Choose “How are things holding up here?” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-227: "How're things?" She snorts and throws a glowing horseshoe into a bucket of water. The steam hisses louder than her temper.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-228:
“If you like rain…, Mud, Bad tools, There's also a priest who keeps mumbling about ancient iron anvils while I'm busy preventing them from melting away, That situation was quite good.”
She smiled, though it was a tired smile.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-229: "Korr keeps barkin' about killin' the dragon, and I'm the one fixin' their bloody axes when they chip 'em on rocks." She exhales.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-230: "Still, could be worse. The forge still burns, and the ale hasn't run dry... yet."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-231: "Back for another chat? I swear, ye folk talk more than ye fight." She smirks and keeps hammering as she speaks.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-232: "Well, go on then. Ask what ye came to ask."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-233: Choose “Never mind. We will come back later.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-234: What can you tell us about the dragon?
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-235: What do you know about this Soulforge?
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-236: What's your take on Captain Korr?
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-238: Choose “What can you tell us about the dragon?” (The Dragon is dead)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-239: "The dragon?" Brenna pauses mid-swing, the hammer hovering above the anvil.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-24: You lift the Spirit Lantern. Its glow strengthens, flooding the grave with cold light.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-240: A slow grin creeps across her soot-streaked face. "Dead, then. Good. About time something in these cursed halls stayed down when hit."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-241: "Korr calls it victory, Durok says it meant something, and me?" She taps the anvil. "I'll finally sleep without feeling its breath shake the forge. Well done."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-242: Choose “What can you tell us about the dragon?” (The dragon is still alive)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-243: "The dragon?" Brenna exhales sharply, but not without a hint of respect.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-244: "So you let the beast live. Hnh. Not what I'd have hoped for."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-245: Choose “What can you tell us about the dragon?” (The Dragon is not yet dead, The Dragon is dead)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-246: "The dragon?" Brenna snorts, wiping sweat and soot from her brow.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-247: "Still out there. Big, loud, and a damned nuisance. Every time it shifts in its sleep, half the camp wakes thinkin' it's the end."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-248: "Korr wants it dead, Durok wants it spared, and I just want it gone so we can get some damned sleep."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-249: Choose “What do you know about this Soulforge?”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-250: "The Soulforge? Aye, Durok won't shut up about it. But I heard those tales from me gran long before he came along."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-251: "They say the old gods forged the mountains there. Every spark that flew from the anvil became a star."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-252: "Durok calls it the Anvil o' Creation. Says it can bring dead metal to life." She wipes soot from her brow, smearing a black streak across her cheek.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-253: "Me gran said a true smith could hear the Soulforge sing. I used to press me ear to our anvil, hopin' for a tune." She chuckles."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-254: "If the Soulforge's real, I'd give me hammer to see it once - just once - burnin' again."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-255: Choose “What's your take on Captain Korr?”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-256: "Korr?" She chuckles softly. "Good lad. Stubborn as a mule in armor. He's keepin' the camp in one piece."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-257: "Don't tell him I said it, but if he wasn't here, we'd all be dragon food by now."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-258: Choose “Can you teach us some dwarven craft?”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-259: "Hah! Ye think swingin' a hammer or pickaxe is all it takes, lad?" She grins, voice carrying over the hiss of the forge. "There's art in it. Patience, rhythm, and a bit o' madness."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-26: A Soul Warden pulls itself from the black soil, dragging pale light behind it like chain.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-260: "Still... I can teach ye the basics. How to break through a hard cave-in without buryin' yer friends, and how to read the shimmer of a gold vein before it runs cold."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-261: (Pay 30 coins) Learn to clear Hard Cave-ins.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-262: (Pay 40 coins) Learn to mine Gold Veins.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-263: Never mind. We will come back later.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-264: Choose “(Pay 30 coins) Learn to clear Hard Cave-ins.” (I've learned how to clean up hard-to-clean messes)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-265: "Ye already know how to swing proper." She chuckles, crossing her arms. "I can sell ye another pick if ye wore the last one down to splinters. Ten coins - fair deal."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-267: Choose “(Pay 10 coins) Buy another pickaxe.” (Have at least 10 gold coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-268: "There. Don't break this one on purpose, lad - I'm runnin' out of handles."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-269: Choose “(Pay 10 coins) Buy another pickaxe.” (Fewer than 10 gold coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-27: For a moment its wake feels... incomplete. As if it is only part of what was bound.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-270: "What, hopin' I'd gift it to ye? The forge don't run on charity. Come back when ye've got coin."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-271: Choose “(Pay 30 coins) Learn to clear Hard Cave-ins.” (Have at least 30 Gold Coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-272: "There ye go. Next time a tunnel falls on yer head, ye might just live long enough to curse about it." She laughs and slaps your shoulder with a sooty hand.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-273: "Now listen close, lad. When ye hit a cave-in, don't swing like a mad troll - ye chip the rock, find the cracks, and make the mountain do the breakin' for ye." She gestures toward the forge, mimicking short, controlled strikes.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-274: "Ye'll also need proper tools. Luck's got no place underground." She turns, rummages through a pile of gear, and tosses you a heavy pickaxe, its handle dark with age.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-275: "That's a dwarven make - solid oak shaft, rune-carved head. Not fancy, but she'll bite through stone like a drunk through tavern bread. Take care of her, and she'll take care o' you."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-276: "Now get out there and practice before ye forget what I said."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-277: Choose “(Pay 30 coins) Learn to clear Hard Cave-ins.” (Fewer than 30 gold coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-278: "Empty purse, empty lessons. Come back when ye can pay for proper teachin'."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-279: Choose “(Pay 40 coins) Learn to mine Gold Veins.” (Learned how to mine gold veins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-28: A Soul Warden rises from the split earth, then falters as the Spirit Lantern's light bites into it.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-280: "Already smellin' gold in yer sleep, are ye? Aye, I taught ye well." She wipes her hands and grins. "Unless ye want another golden chisel for twenty coins. Cuts veins clean as a scalpel."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-282: Choose “(Pay 20 coins) Buy Dwarven Golden Chisel.” (Have at least 20 gold coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-283: "There ye go. Sharp as an orcish saber. Treat her well, and don't pick teeth with it."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-284: Choose “(Pay 20 coins) Buy Dwarven Golden Chisel.” (Fewer than 20 gold coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-285: "Come back when yer purse jingles proper."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-286: Choose “(Pay 40 coins) Learn to mine Gold Veins.” (Have at least 40 Gold Coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-287: "So ye want to learn how to chase gold, eh? Careful. More folk die from greed than cave-ins."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-288: "First lesson. Gold hides in the dullest places. If it shines too bright, it's already been stolen. Watch for hairline gleam in cold stone, not the glitter in torchlight."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-289: "Second. Never dig alone, never dig too deep, and above all, never dig drunk."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-290: "And here - ye'll need this." She hands you a narrow golden chisel. "Dwarven make. It'll cut clean, if ye've got the hand for it. Just don't lose it in the dark."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-291: "Now get out there and see if the mountain thinks yer worthy of her gold."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-292: Choose “(Pay 40 coins) Learn to mine Gold Veins.” (Fewer than 40 gold coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-293: "Can't buy wisdom with promises, lad. Come back when ye've enough coins."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-294: "I can teach ye how to break through a hard cave-in without buryin' yer friends, and how to read the shimmer of a gold vein before it runs cold."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-295: The forest path thins to a muddy track between dark pines. A rough barricade blocks the way.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-296: Behind it stands a lone dwarf, armor dull with soot, warhammer at his shoulder.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-297: He squints through the mist, raising a hand. "Oi! Hold there!" he calls. "This is the edge o' Duskhollow. No strangers pass without reason."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-298: "So speak plain. Why should I let you through?"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-299: The dwarf looks up as you approach again.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-3: Event opening (Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” In progress, The torches have been broken)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-30: You step back from the burned cross. The whisper fades behind you, swallowed by the forest.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-301: He shifts the hammer on his shoulder.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-302: "So. Got a better reason this time?"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-303: "You again." He squints through the rain. "Still outside. That can change, if your manners improve."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-306: We're looking for the dwarven expedition. (once only)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-307: We ran into a dragon in the woods. (once only)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-308: "Easy, brother. Ask what you need to." (Party member required: Dwarf, Available once)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-309: Choose “We're looking for the dwarven expedition.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-31: A low hum fills the clearing. A dwarf kneels before the old stone, tracing runes in the dust.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-312: "Half the fools in these woods claim they're looking for it."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-313: He rests the hammer head in the mud.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-315: "We came looking for Durok." (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-32: Faint runes glow across his armor. As he looks up, you notice a strange light reflected in his eyes, as though he were staring into a fire only he can see.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-320: "Try again when you know who you're talking about."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-324: "Then tell me this. Is he a priest or a warrior?"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-328: "Good. At least you've heard something worth hearing. Go on, then. Captain Korr will want a word."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-33: "Step careful, traveler." His voice is deep and slow. "The mountain listens here." He rises to his feet, hammer in hand, the faint glow of runes crawling across it.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-330: His grip tightens on the hammer.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-332: Choose “Easy, brother. Ask what you need to.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-335: "Fine then. Tell me this: which clan's hammer hangs above Dun Kareth's old gate?"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-338: Try to remember. (Party member required: Dwarf, Available once)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-34: "I am Durok Stonevein, keeper of what remains, seeker of what was lost."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-340: You search your memory. Not your clan, not your halls... but the name comes back anyway.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-345: "Go on then. And try not to make us regret it."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-349: "Either you're a poor dwarf... or a liar."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-35: Durok stands at the ruins, eyes fixed on the shadows beyond.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-350: Choose “We ran into a dragon in the woods.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-351: "You saw it? Big red bastard. Keeps the road closed and our men half-mad."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-352: He studies you a moment longer, rain dripping from his beard.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-353: "Still doesn't mean I open the palisade for every fool who crossed its path."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-354: Choose “(Offer 10 coins) For the watch.” (Have at least 10 gold coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-355: The dwarf weighs the coins in his hand.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-356: "Call it a contribution to the watch."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-358: Choose “(Offer 10 coins) For the watch.” (Fewer than 10 gold coins)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-359: "Empty purse, eh? Come back when you've got coin."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-36: Follow up dialogue (Quests “Heart of the Mountain” In progress, The Dragon is dead)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-360: Choose “(Offer beer) For the rain.” (With Beer)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-361: The dwarf takes the bottle and sniffs it.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-364: Choose “(Offer beer) For the rain.” (Without Beer)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-365: "Ye talk of beer, but I smell none. Don't test a thirsty dwarf's patience, lad."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-366: You turn back into the forest.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-367: The trees open into a rough dwarven camp. Timber walls, smoking forges, and half-finished huts wedged between the roots.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-368: Hammering rings through the clearing, sparks drifting in the dusk light. Dwarves move between fires and workbenches, armor laid out on crates, tools scattered like fallen steel.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-369: The forge spits and growls, casting red light across the house walls. A dwarf stands by the anvil. Broad, scarred, his beard matted with soot and iron rings. His armor's battered, the look of someone who's fought more than he's rested.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-37: "So it's true," he says, voice low and shaking. "The wyrm's fire has gone out." He looks past you.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-370: "Well now, fresh faces in this cursed hole," he says, squinting through the smoke.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-371: "Name's Korr. Captain of the guard. Just the poor soul makin' sure the rest don't drink themselves to death."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-372: Korr leans on his hammer. "Back again, are ye? Thought maybe the wind had scared ye off."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-373: Dialogue options (The Dragon is not yet dead, The Dragon is dead)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-375: Offer your help with the dragon.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-378: How are things after the dragon's death? (once only)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-379: Dialogue options (The dragon is still alive)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-38: "I asked for mercy, not for this." His hammer trembles in his grip. "You've slain more than a beast. You've silenced an echo of what once bound our forge to the world."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-380: Ask how he's been since the dragon. (once only)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-381: Choose “How are things after the dragon's death?” (Defeated the dragon with the help of the dwarf team, Quests “The Last Forge Burns” Not yet failed)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-382: "Since the dragon?" Korr exhales through his nose, a sound halfway between a laugh and a sigh. "Aye, word spread fast. A whole party against a wyrm... You made a tale the bards won't shut up about."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-383: "Durok didn't like it much, of course." He grins faintly. "Let him talk. You did what none of us could. The beast's gone, and the lads sleep easier."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-384: He claps your shoulder, metal on metal. "You've earned more than a drink, friend. The lads sleep easier because of what you did."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-385: Choose “How are things after the dragon's death?” (Defeated the dragon with the help of the dwarf team, Quests “The Last Forge Burns” Failed)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-386: "Since the dragon?" Korr exhales, then gives a rough laugh.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-387: "I owe you an apology. Thought you were a coward. Turns out you just wanted the beast for yourself."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-388: He claps your shoulder, hard enough to rattle armor.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-389: "One band against a wyrm... that's a tale worth drinking to. Come on, have one with me."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-39: "Go, then. Celebrate your victory if you must. But remember that the dragon guarded something we came here to restore."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-390: Choose “How are things after the dragon's death?” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-391: "How've I been?" Korr lets out a booming laugh that echoes through the stone. "By the forge, I still see that wyrm's jaw crack under our last blow. What a fight!"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-392: "You and me, side by side, hammer and blade. That's how legends start, lad." He grins, eyes bright beneath the soot. "Even Durok can't take that away, though he's tried. Stripped me of command. Says I've done enough harm for one age."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-393: "Maybe he's right... But the wyrm's gone, and for the first time in months, the camp sleeps without the sound of its breathing beneath us." He chuckles. "Come, we'll raise a mug to that."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-394: Choose “How are things after the dragon's death?” (No branch has been triggered for defeating dragons alone or using explosives to collaborate in the campaign)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-396: "Durok says the way to the ruins is open. Says it's time to find his bloody Soulforge."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-397: He lowers his voice. "Truth is, he's furious. Doesn't show it much, but everyone can feel it."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-398: "A few lads are talking about heading home. Others just keep their heads down and sharpen axes."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-399: He spits, jaw tight. "Damn place'll cost us more lives before it's done. But maybe, just maybe, we'll find the reason we came here in the first place."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-4: Event opening (Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” Failed, The torches have been broken)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-40: Follow up dialogue (Quests “Heart of the Mountain” In progress, The dragon is still alive)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-402: "Half the lads complain about the food. The other half complain there isn't enough ale."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-403: Choose “Ask about the camp.” (Quests “Ale of Desperation” Completed)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-404: "Though lately they're saying the ale tastes strange. Brenna swears it's the barrels."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-405: "Armor's getting patched, weapons sharpened. Same as every dwarven camp I've ever seen."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-406: Choose “Ask about the camp.” (Quests “Ale of Desperation” Not completed yet)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-407: Choose “Ask how he's been since the dragon.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-408: "How am I?" Korr chuckles, the sound rough as gravel. "Still breathing. That's a start."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-409: "Never thought I'd see the day we'd drive off a wyrm and live to drink about it."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-41: He closes his eyes for a moment, as if offering a silent prayer. When he speaks again, his voice is steady.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-410: "You were right to talk sense into me. If we'd lit those fuses, the whole bloody mountain would've buried us along with the beast."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-411: He grips your shoulder with a gauntleted hand. "You saved more than that dragon, lad. You saved the rest of us too. For that... you've got my respect and my next round of ale."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-412: "You'd be surprised how much cheer returns to a camp when a dragon stops eating them."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-413: He allows himself a faint smile. "Durok's already talking about the ruins and the Soulforge."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-414: "Soon we'll pack up and head below. At least this time it feels like we might actually come back."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-416: "Aye, the wyrm." He spits in the dirt. "We drove it back once, cost me good lads. Their graves are still fresh out by the ruins."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-417: "Durok calls it a sacred guardian, says it's not meant to be slain. Maybe he's right, but I see a corpse that hasn't realized it yet."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-418: "I've had my fill of waitin'. Every day we sit on our arses, that beast dreams of fire and dwarven bones. I'm done waitin' for death to knock. I'll meet it halfway, with an axe in my hand."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-419: "You look like folk who've bled before and didn't break. Stand with us, and you'll have your share of the hoard it's sleepin' on. Fair trade. Blood for gold, courage for song."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-42: "The wyrm lives. There is still wisdom in this world."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-420: "This whole damned expedition's been about the Anvil of Creation. Durok's dream, his crusade, call it what ye will. He swore the relic would save us, bring back the strength of the old clans."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-421: "It's been months now, and we've barely cracked the outer halls. Every tunnel's cursed, half-collapsed, or crawlin' with things that don't belong in stone. We've lost good men just tryin' to hold the entrance."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-422: "Durok's near his wits' end, though he'll never admit it. Keeps mutterin' about signs and omens while the rest of us dig graves."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-423: "And me? I've had enough of sittin' here while that bloody wyrm sharpens its teeth on the bones of our dead. Waitin' won't save us."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-424: "The camp's barely holdin' together. The lads are worn thin from waitin' and fightin' off whatever crawls out of the dark. Half of 'em sleep with one eye open, the other on their blade."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-425: "And that's not even countin' the wyrm. It came at us once already. We drove it back, but three good men didn't walk away."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-426: "I've always stood by Durok, still do in my way. But this time he's wrong. While he prays for signs, my men rot waitin' for the next attack. I won't have us die on our knees when we can die on our feet."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-427: Choose “Offer your help with the dragon.” (Quests “The Last Forge Burns” Failed)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-428: Korr lets out a harsh laugh, more grit than humor. "Now you come crawlin' back?" He shakes his head.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-429: "You had your chance. When the wyrm burned my lads, you turned tail. I don't fight beside cowards."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-43: "You have spared more than a life today. The Soulforge will not forget it."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-430: Choose “Offer your help with the dragon.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-431: Korr eyes the party, voice low and gravelly.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-432: "You mean it, eh? Hah. Thought all the brave ones were already buried."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-433: "I'm done sittin' here countin' ghosts while that scaled bastard snores beside us. We'll take whoever's still got fight in 'em, march through the old shaft, and bring the roof down on its cursed head."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-434: "If we're lucky, the beast dies quick. If not, we die swingin', and that's a death worth the tale."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-435: Choose “Offer your help with the dragon.” (Quests “The Last Forge Burns” Not yet failed)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-436: "If you're still willin' to stand with us, now's the time to say it. Once we move, there's no turnin' back."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-438: Agree to join the dragon hunt.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-44: He places a heavy dwarven mace into your hands.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-442: "We don't charge in blind." Korr spits, rubbing a hand along his beard.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-443: "Powder. Barrels. Enough to make it cough its own fire."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-445: "We set the charges where the tunnels meet the wyrm's pit, light the fuse, and run like a goblin who forgot to pay for his beer."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-446:
“If the explosion doesn’t kill it…, It doesn’t matter. It has no sky to escape to.
We charge in, The axe is drawn, Push it into its own ruins.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-447: "Move quiet. Strike hard. And if the plan goes to hell..." He grins. "Make sure that bastard pays for every dwarf it takes."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-448: Choose “Agree to join the dragon hunt.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-449: "Good. I'll have the lads ready by dawn. Pack light and bring your best weapons. And potions. Lots of potions."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-45: "Durok's Promise. May it strike true when the time comes."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-450: "If we live, the ale's on me."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-452: "We're ready to move," Korr says, lowering his voice. "If you need to sharpen steel or steady your nerves, do it now. Once we march, the beast gives no second chances."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-456: "Ha! Thought so. Another bunch of soft-bellied heroes who talk big till the fire's at their feet." Korr laughs, a harsh, rolling sound.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-457: "Go on, then. We'll face the beast without ye."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-458: He turns back to the anvil and resumes hammering, ignoring you.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-46: Follow up dialogue (Quests “Heart of the Mountain” Not currently in progress, The Dragon is dead)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-460: The dwarves halt before an overgrown hollow at the foot of the cliffs. Ferns spill from the cracks, and the boards that once sealed the passage have rotted to splinters.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-461: "So this is it," Korr says, brushing moss from a cracked rune. "The old shaft."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-462: He kneels to clear the rubble, pulling loose a few broken boards.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-463: "Beyond lies the old mine passage and the wyrm's den, if the old maps were true."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-464: Korr turns to your company. The dwarves stand close, their faces lit by the flicker of a single torch.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-465: "Brothers!" he calls. "We've buried enough of our own. Today we put an end to this. No more running from that damned beast!"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-466: The dwarves answer with a chorus of shouts, raising their weapons.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-467: "Stay close, lad." Korr lowers his voice.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-468: He raises his axe, the metal catching a pale glint of dawn through the trees. "Let's wake the mountain."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-469: Select “Leave him be.” / “Step away for now.” / “We need more time.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-47: "Korr's flame burns too bright," he says at last. "And you stood beside it." He turns away, jaw tight, as the forge wind stirs his cloak.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-470: "Aye, leave me to the forge. It's the only thing here that still listens."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-471: You step away. Behind you, Korr's hammer rings against the anvil, steady and defiant.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-472: Event opening (Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” Not yet failed)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-473: The Soul Warden drifts beneath the hanging lantern. The flame inside trembles.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-474: For a moment, the light and the wraith lean toward one another - like halves of the same wound.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-477: "Begone. You have no place in this world." (Requires Paladin)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-478: Choose “Begone. You have no place in this world.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-479: You step forward, raising your weapon as light gathers along its edge.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-48: "He promised me the mountain would endure. Instead he fed it blood and fire." His eyes flick to you. Not accusing, only tired.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-480: The blow lands with a burst of radiant force, tearing through the warden's form.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-481: The spirit shrieks as its shape fractures, pieces of it unraveling into fading light.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-482: For a moment, it almost collapses completely... almost gone.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-484: Above, the lantern flickers wildly. The warden steadies itself, weakened, but still bound to this world.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-486: You smash the lantern. The glass bursts apart and the trapped flame surges out.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-487: The light rushes toward the warden, wrapping around it like a second fire.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-488: The two lights collide in a blinding flash. For a heartbeat they burn as one.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-489: When your sight returns, the glade is quiet. Only a few fading embers drift through the air.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-49: "You did what you thought right. I will not judge that. But I will judge him." He slams his hammer into the stone, obviously angry.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-490: Among the shattered glass, a small iron key lies in the ash.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-492: The warden stiffens as you step forward. The lantern's flame flares, then shrinks to a thin, watchful line.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-493: A lantern hangs from one of the pale trunks, swaying gently. Its glow is soft.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-494: The light inside feels alive. It flickers like something trapped, brushing again and again against the inner wall of the glass.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-495: The birch glade lies still. The lantern hangs dimly, its light pale and weak.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-496: Event opening (The torches have been broken)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-497: Only shards of glass cling to the blackened chain. Whatever once burned here is gone.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-498: Broken glass glitters at your feet. The birches stand quiet now.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-499: Smash the lantern to pieces. (once only)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-5: The burned cross marks a grave that will answer no more.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-50: "So the tremors were your doing," Durok says. "We felt the mountain shudder all the way to camp." He studies you. Torn, bloodied, and still standing.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-501: Nock an arrow and shoot the lantern. (Party member required: Ranger, Available once)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-502: Sense what clings to the light. (Party member required: Blood Mage, Available once)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-503: Choose “Sense what clings to the light.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-504: You focus your senses on the faint energy within the lantern. A ripple of corruption runs through it, old and bound to pain. Demonic residue clings to the light like oil on water.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-505: Choose “Nock an arrow and shoot the lantern.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-506: You draw your bow and take aim. The whispering stops. The woods fall silent.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-507: The arrow flies and the lantern bursts in a rain of glass and light. The glow spills across the ground, twisting into form.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-508: Choose “Inspect the lantern.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-509: You approach the tree to study the chain and the bark. The wood around the metal is blackened as if burned from the inside.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-51: "You fought the wyrm alone. Bold... or mad." His gaze drifts toward the dark of the ruins. "Do you even know what it was you struck down?"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-510: Inside the glass, something shifts. The glow pulses as if it recognizes you.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-511: The lantern sways softly, its light steady but watchful. Nothing else reveals itself.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-513: Reach out and touch the lantern.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-514: Choose “Stand still and listen.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-515: You stand still among the birches. The light sways gently and the air grows colder.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-516: Something murmurs inside the glass. Words are lost in the sound but you can almost hear fragments of a human voice.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-517: Lean closer to hear it. (once only)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-52: "That flame was not just beastfire. It was bound to the forges beneath, the last breath of the Soulforge." He exhales slowly, the anger gone, replaced by quiet sorrow.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-521: The light flares once, a blurred face pressed against the glass. Then gone.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-522: The voice fades leaving the forest in uneasy silence.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-523: You wait and listen again, but the glade remains quiet. The lantern gives no sound now.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-524: Choose “Reach out and touch the lantern.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-525: Your fingers meet the cold surface of the glass. For an instant it feels like skin beneath ice.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-526: The shape inside turns toward you. A whisper crawls into your thoughts.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-527: Choose “Reach out and touch the lantern.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-529: A flash of fire through birch branches. Then a charred cross. Then darkness.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-53: "Still... you did what no dwarf could. Hero, fool, or both."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-530: The lantern remains cold. No movement, no whisper. Only a dim light inside the glass.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-532: You smash the lantern against the trunk. The glass bursts with a sharp crack.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-533: The light inside flares, then collapses into a scream.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-534: A Soul Warden rises from the spilled glow, its hollow eyes burning with hunger.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-535: You step back. The lantern sways softly on its chain.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-536: The forest breaks into a blackened clearing. Ash coats your boots, and the air reeks of burnt steel and death.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-537: Shattered weapons and charred bones lie among scorched stumps, a battlefield frozen in ruin.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-538: A shadow sweeps overhead. A red dragon cutting across the clouds, its roar rolling through the trees like thunder.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-54: Follow up dialogue (Quests “Heart of the Mountain” Not currently in progress, The dragon is still alive)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-540: For long hours you walked through the dark tunnel beneath the mountains. Stone above, stone below and nothing stirring in between.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-541: Only the Wolf Queen's blessing kept the journey peaceful. In any other tunnel, something would surely have found you first.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-542: At last, a pale green light bled into the passage. The tunnel opened and Duskhollow Woods lay before you.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-543: Tangle of wild forest pressed between the northern mountains and nowhere.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-544: No maps chart these woods. No marked trails promise safe return.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-55: "The mountain shook," Durok says quietly. "We saw the wyrm rise from the smoke and vanish into the clouds."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-56: He studies you. Scorched, silent, alive. "So it was you. You drove it off."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-57: "Mercy that strong... the mountain will remember it." He nods once. "If fate led you there, it may lead you still."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-6: Event opening (Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” Completed)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-60: Ask about the situation in the camp.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-67: "The flame has shown me your path." Durok's voice rolls low.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-68: "I will grant you passage into the ruins. We will follow soon enough, once my people can stand again."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-69: His eyes narrow beneath the firelight. "If you find anything below... anything dangerous, strange, or worthy of the Soulforge, return at once and report it to me."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-7: A single blade of grass grows through the ash, swaying gently in the breeze. Whatever once haunted this place is finally at rest.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-70: Choose “Ask about the Soulforge.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-71: "The Soulforge, the Anvil of Creation." He gestures toward the dark entrance. "It lies below these ruins. They say it burns with the first spark the gods ever struck."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-72: "It can temper more than steel, soul and fate alike. That is why we came. Wake it and forge our kin anew." His gaze follows the faint glow of molten light within the stone.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-73: "But the camp is weary, and Korr's men are spent. If we press deeper now, we'll lose more than we find."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-74: "The wyrm must be dealt with, but not slain. Only then can we descend in safety. Until that's done, the Soulforge will have to wait."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-75: "Still thinking of the Soulforge, are ye? But dreams won't open the way. Until the wyrm is stilled and Korr's men can stand without fear, we can't move a step closer."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-76: "See to the beast first. Then we'll speak of fire and gods again."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-78: "The expedition, aye." Durok lowers his gaze, eyes catching the forge light. "We left the lower halls of Dun Kareth near a year past, twenty strong, all sworn to the same purpose."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-79: "I saw it before the call came, in dreams and in the fire's reflection, a forge beneath the world waiting to wake again."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-8: Event opening (Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” In progress, Quests “The Light That Burns Twice” Not yet failed, The torches are still intact)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-80: "Few believed me, fewer still believe now. Yet the vision burns clear, and it led us here, to this mountain, to the edge of the Soulforge itself."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-81: "The cost has been high, and faith wears thin. Mine does not."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-82: Choose “Ask about the dragon.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-83: "You have heard the roars, have you not?" Durok lowers his head for a moment, as if weighing his words. "The wyrm still lives. Killing it would be madness. To understand it, that is the true test."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-84: "Korr has buried too many men. I understand his anger. But he sees only a monster to be killed, not the guardian it once was."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-85: "The wyrm still breathes. I see its shadow each time I close my eyes. Tell me, traveler... has the mountain spoken to you as well?"
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-86: Tell him about Korr's plan to attack the dragon.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-87: (Lie) Assure him the dragon will remain unharmed.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-88: "I have already told you what must be done. When the time comes... choose wisely."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-89: "I pray our paths still lead to light." His gaze lingers on you.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-9: Lonely wooden cross stands among the roots, its surface charred black and split by time.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-90: Choose “Tell him about Korr's plan to attack the dragon.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-91: "So, Korr spoke, did he?" Durok's gaze drifts past you as if hearing echoes only he can understand. "I felt his intent before you said a word. The mountain knows his choice."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-92: "The wyrm's breath feeds the flame. If it dies, the fire dies with it." His grip tightens on the hammer.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-93: "If battle comes, let it flee, not perish. Strike the pillars, seal the chamber."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-94: Choose “(Lie) Assure him the dragon will remain unharmed.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-95: "Aye, perhaps." Durok's eyes drift past you, unfocused, as if watching something only he can see. "The fire below shows many paths, yet all end in the same way."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-96: "I would have the wyrm rest, not burn. But the mountain whispers that steel is already moving, whether I wish it or no." His voice softens, heavy with the weight of knowing.
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-97: "Go then. Do what you must. Truth will find us both."
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-98: Choose “Ask about the situation in the camp.”
maps.points.west_woods.dialogue-99: "The camp?" He sighs, weary in his tone. "They grow restless. The forge's hum is faint, the nights too long. Korr holds them together by grit and iron, but his patience thins."
maps.points.west_woods.e10.quest-guide: Choose "Do you have any tasks to complete?" to accept this quest alongside "Iron and Ash".
maps.points.west_woods.e10.quest-guide-1: Requires 1 piece of Moonsteel Ore and 50 Gold Coins. You will receive equipment and 300 XP.
Requires 2 pieces of Moonsteel Ore. You must have 100 Gold Coins on you. After deducting 50 Gold Coins, you will receive equipment and 400 XP.
maps.points.west_woods.e10.quest-guide-3: Collect 10 Green Alecaps in Duskhollow Woods.
maps.points.west_woods.e10.quest-guide-4: Bring them back to the camp and select "Regarding those tasks..." → "We have some mushrooms." You will earn 200 XP and 50 gold coins.
maps.points.west_woods.e10.quest-guide-5: Choose "Do you have any tasks to complete?" to accept the quest for Moonsteel forging.
maps.points.west_woods.e10.quest-guide-6: Obtain Moonsteel Ore from chests and containers near Sanctum of the Last Flame or the Soul Forge.
maps.points.west_woods.e10.quest-guide-7: With the ore, select "Regarding those tasks..." → "We have found some Moonsteel Ore." Then choose the equipment you want to forge. The task is completed upon the first forging, and each piece of equipment can only be forged once.
maps.points.west_woods.e10.quest-guide-9: Each boot requires 1 piece of Moonsteel Ore and 50 gold coins. You will earn 250 XP upon obtaining the equipment.
